description: Not enough graded stems available on the shelf to fill the box to packrate.
name: Insufficient stock on shelf

description: The bucket being packed ran out before the box reached its packrate.
name: Bucket exhausted mid-box

description: Stems were rejected/discarded for quality during packing, reducing the box below packrate.
name: Quality rejection

description: Only a shorter/longer length than ordered was available, so the box was packed short.
name: Wrong stem length available

description: The sales order line was reduced or changed after stock was allocated for this box.
name: Order quantity reduced after allocation

description: Packing was cut off for dispatch before the box could be completed.
name: End of day / cutoff

description: Remaining stems for this box are in transit from another farm and not yet available.
name: Awaiting transfer from another farm

description: One or more varieties in the bouquet recipe were short, capping the whole bunch/box.
name: Mixed bunch recipe shortfall
